_comment: Robot vertical collision envelope for the Atlas3R 3D occupancy field. The VoxelOccupancyGrid3D is bounded to [floor, floor + collision_height_m + margin_m] along the floor axis; resolution is spent only inside this envelope (the robot never collides with the ceiling). Units are meters. Defaults model a standard floor-cleaning robot. The last fields are the candidate occupancy-estimation policy (applied ONLY to the monocular candidate, never the measured GT). This policy is TUNED FOR THE MAPANYTHING BACKBONE (the default M3 geometry source as of the MapAnything adoption): its dense, high-coverage geometry benefits from the directional free-carve truncation (free_carve_margin_m: retract the grazing-ray flood directly below a confident surface) PLUS gravity support (occupancy_support_height_m: fill UNKNOWN band voxels below a confident obstacle, hit count >= occupancy_support_min_count). On the SPARSE DA3 backbone the truncation regressed per-class so it was OFF; on MapAnything it is a net win (occ_iou + band_fsc) holding per-class up vs the old DA3 default. See docs/sota_backbone_research.md (Section 0b) and docs/band_obstacle_recall_evidence.md.
